name: 08094 · Williamstown, NJ
findings: ZIP 08094 (Williamstown) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08094 (Williamstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
